title: Strategy spec
description: What the user asked for, as explicit rules. The language model writes this; the engine runs it. The spec is closed on purpose: it has no stop-loss, take-profit or entry-price field, so an exit can only happen by leaving the ranking. Decimals are fractions: 0.0015 means 15 bps. Dates use ISO 8601.

universe.description: Named universe the screen reads, for example an index. The engine resolves it point-in-time.

sharia.description: A filter that runs before ranking. Under compliant_only an unknown name is excluded, never kept.

filters.description: Hard conditions a name must pass to be ranked. May be empty.

rank.description: Factors the survivors are ranked by, equal weight. Order is not meaningful.

n_drop.description: Most names replaced per rebalance. Required, so a spec always states how a holding ends: by rank.

fee_rate.description: Fee per unit traded, fraction of notional.

slip_rate.description: Slippage per unit traded, fraction of notional.
